    # Fill each diagonal family according to the encoded color cycle.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The diagonal color key is the most frequent nonzero color for each
    # residue of (column-row) modulo the inferred period.
    from collections import Counter
    best = None
    for period in range(2, max(h,w)+1):
        bins = [Counter() for _ in range(period)]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                v = grid[r][c]
                if v:
                    bins[(c-r) % period][v] += 1
        score = sum(max(b.values(), default=0) for b in bins)
        coverage = sum(bool(b) for b in bins)
        candidate = (coverage, score, -period, bins)
        if best is None or candidate[:3] > best[:3]:
            best = candidate
    period = -best[2]
    bins = best[3]
    colors = [max(b.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0] if b else 0 for b in bins]
    return [[colors[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
